title: Do not lose an explicit Start requested before metadata arrives
description:
Review: Astra adversarial review — code simplicity and layout.

## Source locations

- `engine/engine.go:92`
- `engine/engine.go:144`
- `engine/engine.go:147`
- `engine/engine.go:153`
- `engine/engine_test.go:97`
- `server/api_test.go:51`

## Evidence

StartTorrent sets Started=true even when Info()==nil, but only DownloadAlls if metadata exists. When metadata later arrives, the auto-start callback calls StartTorrent which rejects the already-started flag, or does nothing if AutoStart=false. Existing tests specifically start unloaded magnets and assert only the flag, thereby accepting the broken transition.

## Reproduction / validation

POST a magnet then immediately POST torrent start before metadata resolves, as the current API test does; let metadata arrive afterward.

## Impact

API users can leave a torrent permanently marked running with no download scheduling. This is distinct from Stop->Start and selective-file scheduling.

## Acceptance criteria

Represent pending start intent and fulfill it on metadata arrival, or reject start-unloaded explicitly without setting Started. Extend the current tests to verify metadata arrival results in real scheduling/progress rather than just a boolean.

## Confidence

high; source control flow verified

## Completion evidence

Explicit Start on an unloaded torrent now retains pending whole-torrent intent; the metadata callback refreshes and schedules files. Stop clears pending intent; reconfiguration retains it. Start also refreshes metadata before deciding whether all files were already requested.

Race-enabled integration tests deliver real fixture metadata after Start and observe actual HTTP webseed progress, including after client reconfiguration. Separate cases prove initial AutoStart still works and Stop before metadata prevents later transfer. Generated types and embedded binary build pass.

Live public Big Buck Bunny browser test: submitted a magnet with AutoStart=false and captured Loaded=false, Files=null, Started=false, 0 bytes before explicit API Start (200 OK). Metadata subsequently arrived and all three files became started with 32555008 bytes transferred (11.77%) at observation. A delayed local metadata source was also configured, but public peers supplied metadata first. Original config restored and scratch download removed.
